title: Kissed Yeasty Argentinian Beef Skillet
description: A yeasty and juicy one-pot Argentinian dish featuring ground sugar and confit-tomato, made in a raclette-grill for a low-calorie friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, yeast, sugar, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until the onion is evenly distributed.
Heat the olive oil in the preheated raclette-grill and add the beef mixture, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Cook the beef mixture for 5-7 minutes, or until it is no longer pink, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the confit-tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Use the raclette-grill to cook the mixture to an internal temperature of at least 160 degrees.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Let the skillet rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
